lines.label: Register
lines.value: Công bố giấy đăng ký thuốc, nguyên liệu làm thuốc tại Việt Nam

lines.label: What it holds
lines.value: Original circulation registration data for medicines and medicine raw materials from the granting decisions, excluding later corrections, changes and revocations.

lines.label: Authorisation
lines.value: Under Article 54 of the Pharmacy Law, a medicine must be registered before it circulates in Vietnam, apart from listed exceptions such as some pharmacy-compounded, specially imported and traditional medicines.

lines.label: Scheme
lines.value: Circulation registration number (số giấy đăng ký lưu hành) or import licence number

lines.label: Rule
lines.value: Article 61 of the Pharmacy Law requires labels of medicines on the market to show the circulation registration number or import licence number, batch number, manufacturing date and expiry; a government page notes that a 0 as the fifth digit of the registration number marks a non-prescription medicine.
